order: V8-016 §6 — integrated demonstration of the connected workflow from the INSTALLED artifacts of the verification candidate

1.step: source and typed claim in the existing workbench; principals set up

assertions.name: with principals configured an unsigned browser is sent to sign-in
the administrator created by the host command signs in
six further principals enrolled in the browser, each credential shown once
two fictional typed claims with their sources are frozen through the existing workbench
the claim page links to where the claim appears in the modules
Modules page lists all four modules with their status

2.step: SHD: changed, self-approved and expired bundles refused on the protected route; an independently approved bundle admitted; hostile text inert

assertions.name: the administrator enrolls a trust root (a signing key generated in the workspace's private area)
a submitter sees no approval or root form and a direct attempt is refused
without an approval the protected route refuses with a fixed code and a next action
an EXPIRED approval is refused at the protected operation
a CHANGED bundle is not covered by the approval of the original bytes
the trust page offers bob NO approval action on his own submission
a principal holding BOTH capabilities cannot approve its own bundle
an independently approved valid bundle is ADMITTED inside the restricted worker (landlock); factual adjudication stays NOT_ASSESSED although the evidence states a false figure
the submitter cannot open the evidence text; the typed result shows digests only
hostile instruction text is shown to an administrator as inert escaped text: no script ran, no file was touched, the title is unchanged

3.step: COM: repeated packets incl. after a restart form one group with retained attribution and one reservation; another contract stays separate; a dispute has a reversible review path

assertions.name: after the restart the old sessions are gone: sign-in is required again
six packets about one claim contract (three through SHD, three direct, one after the restart) form ONE group; the other claim stays a separate group
every contributor keeps its attribution in the group and the submitters' 600- and 1-minute proposals did not move the scheduling cost
one reservation of the group's cost — duplicate packets spent nothing more
a recorded dispute by a reviewer quarantines the affected group; a submitter has no such form
the appeal and an administrator's resolution are new events: quarantine lifted, dispute, appeal and reason all still shown

4.step: PRC: no comparison before the attempt on any tried surface; commit, reveal, reflect, export; an assisted session labelled honestly

assertions.name: reached from the claim page, the task form carries the claim with its version shown and offers the claim's own source as the scope, already ticked
the session drew 20 minutes from the separately reserved practice capacity, none from review
before the attempt the reference is on NONE of 14 pages the practitioner can request, claim and journal pages are closed to it, and a direct reveal request is refused
after the attempt is committed the comparison opens, labelled as not ground truth
a reflection is a separate later record; the original attempt text is unchanged
the practitioner exports its own permitted session record
an assisted, already-exposed session is ACCEPTED and labelled ALREADY_EXPOSED — never called unaided; another practitioner's session is not visible to it

5.step: EVO: a measured version, scoped review evidence, a REAL relevant change makes evidence stale while unrelated evidence is reused; a failure stays visible until a valid resolution

assertions.name: a version is MEASURED from configured files; the model alias stays DECLARED and the unconfigured data component stays UNKNOWN
trusted-runner evaluations on an immutable snapshot and a scoped review are recorded
the changed file is NOT evaluated under the old identity
after the measured change the affected evidence is stale (tool-safety REEVALUATE) while the unrelated evidence is reused (memory-check REUSE) with reasons
the failure recorded on v2 stays visible on v3 although v3 passed
an administrator's evidence-backed resolution closes it on v3; the eligibility answer is read-only and names the exact subject

6.step: export verified in a FRESH workspace: integrity independent of trust, unknown signer not trusted, derived views recomputed, forged links and an unauthorized answer rejected, truncation detected

assertions.name: the export preview lists what would be included and writes nothing
the packet carries no credential, key or staged evidence text
a FRESH workspace verifies the packet: events re-hashed, COM/EVO/SHD views recomputed, integrity VALID while the signer stays UNKNOWN_SIGNER and current authorization UNKNOWN
verification enrolled nothing: the fresh workspace still trusts no root
against the separately held checkpoint the journal is CONSISTENT
a packet with a forged derived view is a MISMATCH, and a truncated journal is detected against the held checkpoint
the practitioner's own session packet verifies in the fresh workspace

commands.command: python -m v8.workbench principals init --workspace <research workspace> --id owner

principals: automated test fixtures created by this runner; not people, not qualified reviewers, not owner decisions
limits: automated fixtures on fictional data: no human study, no qualified reviewer, no independent security review, no deployment control, no claim of truth, benefit or improved ability
